'''Ignasi Fandos''' was the tournament director of the [[2003 Spain National Championship|Spain National Championship]], held on 14 June 2003 at La Ronda, Barcelona.<ref name="pc-intl03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Nationals and Provincials (International Events)], swccgpc.com (2003).
